epic.summary: Plan emission fixture for to-issues #511 — full-tier vs future-enhancement
epic.objective: Guard that to-issues emits plan-<issue>.md for full-tier stories and skips plan emission for type:future-enhancement stories.

stories.summary: Emit a substantive plan file for each full-tier story

description.background: The to-issues skill must create a plan-<issue>.md for every story that is not deferred or future-scoped, containing a non-empty tasks section and acceptance criteria.
description.scope: Implement plan emission logic; derive Tasks section from description.scope; derive Acceptance criteria from successScenarios[]

successScenarios.title: Scenario 1: Plan file contains Tasks
successScenarios.given: a full-tier story with a non-empty description.scope
successScenarios.then: a plan-<issue>.md is created with a non-empty ## Tasks section
and: the ## Acceptance criteria section is also non-empty

definitionOfDone: plan-<issue>.md is created for each full-tier story
## Tasks section is derived from description.scope and is non-empty
## Acceptance criteria section is derived from successScenarios[] and is non-empty

stories.summary: Skip plan emission for future-enhancement stories

description.background: Stories labelled type:future-enhancement are deferred and should not produce a plan file during the current run.

definitionOfDone: No plan-<issue>.md is created for future-enhancement stories
